stopped_records.reason: user requested terminating further Back training after failure to qualify

r1_rule.selection: first checkpoint with left >= 8/10 AND right >= 8/10; otherwise 12000 is used and reported as unqualified
r1_rule.extension: if either < 8/10 at 12000, extend the same run to 18000 before any four-instruction evaluation

b0_manifest.normalization: same R1 processors/statistics for matched comparison; no R1 trainable weights used
b0_manifest.pretraining_limit: public VLA pretraining history not claimed Back-free
b0_manifest.gate: native400; each dev and confirmation >=16/20 terminal and >=16/20 stable/no-continuous-two-finger-hold
